name: Finger Gun
body:
School evocation; Level magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you; see text
Duration 10 minutes; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Upon finishing the casting of this spell, the caster gains a number of ‘shots’ equal to the amount of fingers they have.

As a standard action, by making a gun with their hand, they may shoot one of these shots towards a creature. Treat this as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d3 points of non-lethal force damage. These shots last for 10 minutes or until used.
